en.headline: Mercedes catches fire on Tsing Sha Highway; driver and passenger escape unhurt
en.dek: A 1995 Mercedes S320 erupted in flames near Container Terminal 8 on Saturday night; firefighters raised the incident to a No. 2 alarm before extinguishing the blaze.
body: A Mercedes private car caught fire on Tsing Sha Highway late on Saturday night, forcing the male driver and a female passenger to abandon the vehicle and escape. Neither was injured.

According to reports, the 1995 Mercedes S320 was travelling towards Kowloon on the Stonecutters Bridge section near Container Terminal 8 at about 10.40pm when smoke appeared from the front of the car, followed by flames. The driver pulled onto the hard shoulder and both occupants got out immediately.

Fire Services Department crews arrived and, because the fire was on an elevated roadway with limited water access, classified it as a No. 2 alarm. They extinguished the blaze. The front and cabin of the car were gutted. One traffic lane was closed for a time while the cause is investigated.
Observers noted the driver was wearing a Toy Story character costume at the time of the incident. The passenger left the scene afterwards.

zh.headline: 青沙公路平治起火 司機乘客棄車逃生無人傷
zh.dek: 周六晚上約10時40分，一輊1995年平治S320在昂船洲大橋近八號貨櫃碼頭車頭冒煙起火，消防列作二級火警後將火救熄。
body: 青沙公路周六深夜發生私家車起火事故，男司機與女乘客及時棄車逃生，兩人均沒有受傷。
據報道，涉事1995年平治S320沿昂船洲大橋往九龍方向行駛，至近葵涌八號貨櫃碼頭時，車頭突然冒煙並陷入火海。司機將車駛至路肩停下，兩人立即下車。
消防接報到場，因現場位於大橋、水源有限，將火警升為二級，開喉撲熄。平治車頭及車廂嚴重焚毀。現場一度封閉一條行車線，消防正調查起火原因。
現場所見，男司機身穿《反斗奇兵》角色服裝。女乘客事後已離開。
